summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing for bug fix: protocol number consistency between /confirmacao (c-inscricao) and /inscricao-realizada (r-inscricao). All 4 scenarios PASSED. Protocol format PMVR-XXXXXX-YYYYY generated on /confirmacao page load, stored in sessionStorage.inscricao_dados.__protocolo, and reused on final page. CPF change correctly regenerates protocol with new last-6-digit prefix.
critical_code_review_comments: Protocol suffix uses Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase() which is variable-length (e.g., MS28OUO3, MS28P913) and not always 6 chars — spec says PMVR-XXXXXX-XXXXXX but format observed is PMVR-XXXXXX-YYYYYYYY (8 chars). Not a functional bug but doesn't strictly match the stated pattern.
confirmacao.html script is inline; consider extracting to a module for testability.
seed_data_creation: None. Used CPF 390.533.447-05 and 111.444.777-35 for form submissions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end via Playwright. Protocol generated once on /confirmacao page load and reused on /inscricao-realizada, with correct regeneration on CPF change. Note that the protocol suffix from Date.now().toString(36) can vary in length; if strict PMVR-6-6 is required, change generation to pad/truncate.
